sloka: तां तु भिन्नां शिलां दृष्ट्वा सुग्रीवः क्रोधमूर्च्छितः।सालमुत्पाट्य चिक्षेप राक्षसे रणमूर्धनि ।। ६.९८.१५ ।।
transliteration: tāṁ tu bhinnāṁ śilāṁ dṛṣṭvā sugrīvaḥ krodhamūrcchitaḥ।sālamutpāṭya cikṣepa rākṣase raṇamūrdhani ।। 6.98.15 ।।

translations.english: Seeing the fragmented rock, Sugriva was deluded with anger, and tearing up a sala tree, he shattered on the Rakshasa (Mahodara) in the battlefield.
